inputs.games: data/s9cb/games.csv (nflverse schedules release, closing lines and prices)
inputs.injuries: data/s9cb/injuries.csv (nflverse mirror of the official weekly report)

method_notes.qb_continuity: incumbent = most starts for that club this season in games strictly before this one; week 1 falls back to the previous season's most frequent starter; unknown otherwise, never assumed
method_notes.production_window: the club's previous 4 games in the same season
method_notes.prices: observed only; a bet with no quoted price is excluded and counted
method_notes.multiple_testing: one Benjamini-Hochberg correction over the twelve already published rules plus these five

known_limits: The committed extract has no defensive player statistics, so a defensive deficiency is measured in ruled-out players, not in lost production.
The official report lists game status; it does not list who replaced whom. Replacement identity comes from the depth chart on the main site, not here.
Practice-squad promotions and in-game injuries are not in the report.
The 2026 season is in progress: its rows are small-sample and are shown as such.
